ACTIVE.description: The value of the data entity that is engaging.

CLOSED.description: A component is closed to the point of a positive confirmation.

DOWN.description: Reduction in the behavior of a structural element.

INACTIVE.description: The value of the data entity that is not engaging.

LEFT.description: The position of the composition element is oriented to the left to the           point of a positive confirmation.

OPEN.description: A component is open to the point of a positive confirmation.

RIGHT.description: The position of the composition element is oriented to the right to           the point of a positive confirmation.

TRANSITIONING.description: It is in an intermediate position of the composition element.

UP.description: Increase in the behavior of a structural element.
